## Description
Describe your changes in detail.

## Related Issue
Fixes #(issue) or Relates to #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance enhancement

## Testing & Verification
- [ ] Ran `go test -v -race ./pkg/... ./test` and all tests passed.
- [ ] Added new unit/integration tests covering this change.
- [ ] Formatted code with `go fmt ./...`.
- [ ] Verified cross-platform compatibility if touching network or OS layers.
